description: This file defines the PooledQueueCache class, which implements a message cache for Orleans streaming, optimized for high-volume, long-duration message storage with minimal garbage collection impact. It manages message blocks, cursors for iteration, and metadata purging, and interacts with external components like cache data adapters, loggers, and monitors.

classes.name: PooledQueueCache
classes.description: A cache for streaming messages that uses pooled memory to minimize garbage collection, supporting long-term storage and efficient iteration.

classes.name: Cursor
classes.description: An internal class representing a position within the message cache for iteration purposes.

methods.name: ReportCacheMessageStatistics
methods.description: Reports statistics about the cache to the cache monitor.

methods.name: PurgeMetadata
methods.description: Removes outdated metadata entries based on the purge interval.

methods.name: TrackAndPurgeMetadata
methods.description: Tracks message metadata for purging and updates the purged tokens dictionary.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.description: Positions a cursor at a specific sequence token within the cache.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the next message from the cache at the cursor position.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a list of messages to the cache, updating monitoring and periodic actions.

methods.name: Add (private)
methods.description: Adds a single message to the cache, allocating from the pool and updating the linked list.

methods.name: RemoveOldestMessage
methods.description: Removes the oldest message and associated block if empty, updating metadata.
